name: Lambeau Field Alumni Suite Terrace
lede: At the home of the Green Bay Packers, the Alumni Suite opens onto an 800 sq ft terrace in one of the coldest markets in the US. Six black Tungsten Electric heaters with dimmers keep it welcoming for late-season games.
data: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric 4 kW 277 V, black (6)

photos.caption: Photo: Gunn & Pegelow, via gunnpegelow.com. Permission to publish to be confirmed.

beats: The Alumni Suite at Lambeau Field opens onto an outdoor terrace of 800 sq ft, with high-top tables.
Green Bay is one of the coldest markets in the US: the terrace had to stay welcoming deep into the season.
Gunn & Pegelow and Somerville Architects specified six black Tungsten 4 kW 277 V electric heaters, each on its own dimmer, so the warmth can be turned up or down.
team: Also named: August Winter & Sons, First Supply

products.mount: Drop rod, as photographed – to confirm
products.controls: Dimmer controls – each heater turned up or down
